title: Vocabulary import
scope: English vocabulary · IPA and written pronunciation tips
limits: Separate entries with English or Chinese commas. Up to 20 entries, 100 characters per normalized entry, and 4,000 characters total. Ctrl/⌘ + Enter submits.
generatedNotice: Meanings and pronunciation are model-generated and may contain errors. No audio is included.

outcome.cancelled: Batch cancelled; no new entries saved

cancelNotice.too_late: The batch has reached storage. Waiting for its final result.

errors.INVALID_INPUT: Enter 1–20 nonempty entries (up to 100 characters each and 4,000 total).
errors.BUSY: A vocabulary batch is already running.
errors.REQUEST_NOT_FOUND: This batch is no longer active in this window.
errors.MODEL_NOT_CONFIGURED: Configure a real model in Settings → Models first.
errors.CREDENTIAL_DECRYPT_FAILED: The saved model credential could not be read. Update it in Settings → Models.
errors.MODEL_ERROR: The model request failed. Check the connection and structured-output support, then retry.
errors.INVALID_ANALYSIS: The model returned invalid vocabulary analysis.
errors.UNRECOGNIZED: The English term or its pronunciation could not be identified reliably.
errors.TIMEOUT: Analysis timed out. You can retry this entry.
errors.CANCELLED: Cancelled; this entry was not saved.
errors.STORAGE_FAILED: Vocabulary could not be read or saved. No pending entries were saved.
errors.UNKNOWN_ERROR: The vocabulary request failed. Please retry.
